title: fix(metadata-protocol): an offset with no limit reports the filtered total
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X2pz77pK1zfwZ6XMswiajh2)_

Fixes #28547

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 列表读取只给偏移（`$skip` / `offset`）不给条数时，`total` 现在是符合筛选条件的总行数，不再是“总行数减偏移”。
- **为什么改：** 旧逻辑只在有 limit 时才做计数，没 limit 时直接拿返回行数当总数；有偏移时就少算了偏移那么多行（14 行跳 3 行报 11，偏移超出末尾报 0）。
- **风险与回滚：** 低。只改 `findData` 分页块的一个条件：有偏移无条数的请求走已有的计数路径（多一次 COUNT 查询）。无偏移无条数、有条数、`$count=false` 三种行为不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` 中 `if (pageLimit !== undefined || pageOffset > 0)` 一行及 `$count=false` 分支的 `hasMore`；`protocol.offset-no-limit-total.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.offset-no-limit-total.test.ts`，预期 11 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

`findData` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`) treated a list read as paged only when it carried a limit. Without one it kept `total = records.length`, on the comment "without a limit the full result set is returned". With an offset that is false: the read returns every match after the offset, so `total` short-counted by exactly the offset.

The paged arm now opens on `pageLimit !== undefined || pageOffset > 0`. An offset with no limit runs the same count a paged request runs, over the same `where`, `search` and `searchFields` (#22790). Inside that arm:

- `$count` absent or true: one `engine.count()`, and `total` is the filtered count. `hasMore` is true only while the offset plus the rows returned falls short of the count, so it is false when every row after the offset came back.
- `$count=false`: no count is issued and `total` is omitted (#10757). `hasMore` now reads `pageLimit !== undefined && records.length === pageLimit`, so with no limit it is false (every row after the offset came back). Before, the guard was not needed because this arm was reached only with a limit.

Adding the offset back to `records.length` was measured and rejected: an offset past the end returns no rows, so it would answer `total: 999` for `{"offset":999}` over 14 rows. The count path gives 14.

A read with neither an offset nor a limit is unchanged: no count, `total` is the set length. An explicit `offset: 0` is no offset (`pageOffset` is computed as `> 0`).

## Why

The card's expected result: "`total` is the number of rows matching the filter, whatever the offset, as it already is when a limit is present (and as #22690 / #22588 settled for `$top=0`)." The Console always sends `$top`, so API clients paging with `$skip` alone were the ones reading the wrong number.

## Tests

New suite `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.offset-no-limit-total.test.ts`, on an engine double that honours `offset` and `limit` as written and counts over the same `where` (the shape of `protocol.zero-limit-total.test.ts`), with 14 rows like the showcase's `showcase_account`:

- `GET ?$skip=3&$count=true`: 11 rows, `total` 14, `hasMore` false, one count.
- `POST {"offset":3,"count":true}`: the same.
- `{"offset":999,"count":true}`: no rows, `total` 14.
- The same offset with and without `$top=100` gives the same `total` and rows.
- Absent `$count` with `skip=3`: `total` 14.
- CONTROL: a filter (`tier=b`, 4 rows) with `$skip=1` gives 3 rows and `total` 4, and the count carries the `where`. A `$search` is passed to both `find` and `count`.
- CONTROL, unchanged arms: no offset and no limit issues no count; `offset: 0` issues no count; `offset:3, limit:5` issues one count, `total` 14, `hasMore` true; `$count=false` with an offset (both the GET and the POST spelling) issues no count, omits `total`, returns 11 rows, `hasMore` false.

<details><summary>Red first: the suite against the base protocol.ts (310cb96d)</summary>

The base blob (`81ff63a0`) was written over the file and the suite run, then restored with `git checkout HEAD -- …` (blob back to `5dac1154`, `git diff HEAD` empty).

```
Tests  8 failed | 3 passed (11)
AssertionError: expected 11 to be 14      (GET ?$skip=3&$count=true)
AssertionError: expected 11 to be 14      (POST {"offset":3,"count":true})
AssertionError: expected +0 to be 14      ({"offset":999,"count":true})
AssertionError: expected 3 to be 4        (tier=b, $skip=1)
expected "vi.fn()" to be called 1 times, but got 0 times   ($search)
{"$skip":"3","$count":"false"}: expected true to be false   ($count=false still reported total)
```

The 3 that stay green are the unchanged-arm controls (no offset and no limit, `offset: 0`, a limit).
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: revert only the arm condition on the committed fix</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts --anchor 'if (pageLimit !== undefined || pageOffset > 0) {' --replacement 'if (pageLimit !== undefined) {'`. The test imports `./protocol.js` from `src/`, so no build is involved.

```

anchor-new count: 0
```

</details>

<details><summary>Package suite, typecheck, lint</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build && … typecheck && … test` under the verify lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, `Test Files 290 passed | 4 skipped (294)`, `Tests 21905 passed | 26 skipped (21931)`. The package `tsconfig.json` includes `src/**/*`, so typecheck covers the new test file.
- Neighbouring suites `protocol.zero-limit-total.test.ts` and `protocol.count-opt-out.test.ts` stay green (27 of 27 with the new suite). The count-opt-out pin "`$count=false` without a limit is a no-op" has no offset and is unchanged.
- `eslint packages/metadata-protocol --no-inline-config`: exit 0.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

Other producers of a list `total`, each with a conclusion:

- **RestServer `GET /data/:object` and `POST /data/:object/query`** (`packages/rest/src/crud-routes.ts:164`, `:379`): both call `p.findData`. Fixed here.
- **Dispatcher `GET /data/:object` and `POST /data/:object/query`** (`runtime/src/domains/data.ts` → `action-execution.ts` `callData('query')` → `protocol.findData`, `:779`): fixed here.
- **`findData`'s aggregate branch** (`groupBy` / `aggregations`): no offset reaches `engine.aggregate`, and `total` is the length of the full grouped set. Not affected.
- **MCP HTTP `query_records`** (`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts:1127`, via `runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts:711` `callData('query')`): always sends a limit (`Math.min(limit ?? maxLimit, maxLimit)`), so it already took the count arm. Already correct, and it now shares the fix if that ever changes.
- **Out of scope, observed only (not filed):** `packages/mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.ts:971` (stdio MCP `query`) and the no-protocol fallback in `runtime/src/action-execution.ts` (`total: all.length`, reached only when the metadata-protocol service is not registered) report `records.length` as `total` whatever the offset or limit. That is a different defect (page size reported as total even with a limit), read from source and not measured at a public door, so it is not filed. Carrier: none.

The fix costs one `COUNT` per offset-only read, the same cost a limited read already pays. A caller that wants to avoid it sends `$count=false`.

## Verification

Derived gate list: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `0cd24491` (61 commands, after merging `origin/main` once at `cd065d36` because #28583 touched `protocol.ts`), each run with its exit code captured before any pipe, reconciled with `--ran`.

- `--ran` reconciliation: `61 derived, 61 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN` (`RAN_EXIT=0`), every family exit 0, including `check:type-check-debt` ("0 raw tsc error(s) total, none above its recorded number"), `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:engine-double-contract`, `check:query-options-erasure`, `check:objectql-double-limit` and `check:where-matcher`.
- Package suite re-run on the merged head: `Test Files 291 passed | 4 skipped (295)`, `Tests 21908 passed | 26 skipped (21934)`, typecheck exit 0, `eslint packages/metadata-protocol --no-inline-config` exit 0.
